profile.name: Rodelito Tangonan
profile.headline: Android Developer building native apps with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Clean Architecture
profile.summary: At DigiPlus I co-built ArenaPlus V2 from day one and wrote 53% of its code, from the Gradle architecture to wallet and payment flows. Outside work I ship apps end to end across Android, Compose Multiplatform and AI tooling. This site is one of them: a Compose Multiplatform app compiled to WebAssembly.

services.title: Native Android development
services.description: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose apps from first commit to Play Store, on Clean Architecture and multi-module Gradle builds.

services.title: Hybrid to native migration
services.description: Moving a WebView app to native Android module by module, without stopping releases.

services.title: Payments, wallets and integrations
services.description: Deposit, withdrawal and bank-linking flows, eKYC, payment gateways and Adjust attribution, built to handle money carefully.

services.title: Performance and Play compliance
services.description: Memory and layout tuning under heavy real-time traffic, APK size, skeleton loading, and 16 KB page-size readiness.

services.title: AI features in mobile apps
services.description: LLM features with model routing, cooldowns and on-device fallback, so the app keeps working when a service fails.

services.title: IoT and embedded prototyping
services.description: Microcontroller prototypes (Arduino, ESP8266) connected to the apps that drive them.

projects.title: Pawffice
projects.summary: A local-first, multi-agent AI workspace for the desktop, presented as a 3D town where a crew of cats takes your prompts.
highlights: Classifies each prompt into ordered AI stages and feeds every stage the previous one's output
Pricing gates before anything runs, repository-path isolation and rate-limit handling
13 P0 build-blocking tests guard the cost and security rules

screenshots.caption: The town: walk your cat around while the crew thread on the right takes prompts
Crew members answer in the thread, each in their own role
Onboarding: the CEO cat "hires" you with four questions
The wardrobe: breed, coat and outfit for your cat

projects.title: Vistago
projects.summary: An offline-first AI travel companion for Android: plan trips, translate through the camera, and keep travel memories, with or without a connection.
highlights: 12 feature areas, 16 screens, about 450 composables in 366 Kotlin files
OpenRouter model routing with live discovery, role-based pinning, cooldowns and availability tracking
Falls back to on-device processing when LLM services fail

screenshots.caption: The memory map: photo-hunt pins across Kansai, each with walking directions from where you are
Ask Vistago: photo spots near you, sign translation and travel questions
A planned trip with its countdown, nights, travelers and budget
Smart Budget splits the total by travel style, offline

projects.title: Calm Escape Premier
projects.summary: A multi-tenant booking platform for spas: each spa gets its own booking website and staff dashboard, and customers book from iOS and Android apps that share one schedule.
highlights: 184 pgTAP database tests across 7 suites: tenant isolation, booking rules, availability, promotions, VIP vouchers and the catalog
Row Level Security on all 19 tables, enforced by 51 policies, so each spa sees only its own data
Two Postgres exclusion constraints stop a therapist or room being double-booked, even when two requests race

screenshots.caption: A spa's home in the Android app: pick a day, the first free time today, vouchers and live bundles
A VIP customer's vouchers, each with its expiry date and how many are left
Booking on the spa's website: member prices and each therapist's free times for the day
The staff dashboard's sales for the month: treatments done, bookings still to come, and sales by day

projects.title: BubuProtect
projects.summary: An offline password vault for Android that keeps logins, cards, IDs and Wi-Fi keys encrypted on the device, shows two-factor codes, and checks passwords against known leaks without sending them anywhere.
highlights: One 256-bit vault key wrapped three ways (a paper recovery code, PBKDF2-SHA512 at 210,000 iterations and the hardware Keystore), then split with HKDF into a SQLCipher key and an AES-256-GCM field key
209 unit tests across 22 files cover the crypto, TOTP, CSV import, autofill matching and DNS/packet parsing
Breach check sends only the first 5 characters of each password's SHA-1 hash to Have I Been Pwned, so no password, username or website leaves the phone

screenshots.caption: The vault: logins, cards, IDs, notes and Wi-Fi keys, each marked secure or breached
A login with its live two-factor code and the seconds left before it changes
The security check finds a reused password that has appeared 2.3M times in public leaks
The device check lists phone settings, such as USB debugging, that could expose the vault

projects.title: Seventh J
projects.summary: An inventory and dealer-floor app for a Makati art gallery that puts pending sales, reprices and consignments in front of the owner for approval, beside the month's figures.
highlights: One Compose Multiplatform codebase for Android, iOS and the web: all 77 composable functions live in shared code, and platform code is four small expect/actual files
A 900-stroke painted splash that settles into the logo in 3.3 seconds, trimmed to 260 strokes on the web and skipped when the system asks for reduced motion
Each screen's state is a sealed interface covering loading, error and ready, with 18 @Preview functions

screenshots.caption: Home: the approvals waiting on the owner, with price and discount for each
A sale approval: asking against sold price, who requested it and who bought
The month's gross, works sold and commission, an eight-month sales chart and items to follow up
The launch screen, where painted strokes gather into the Seventh J mark

projects.title: The Eagle's Watch
projects.summary: A civic transparency app that lists Philippine public infrastructure projects with their contracts, schedules, reported progress and source documents, so citizens can check what public money is building.
highlights: Search and filter by status, place, agency, contractor and contract size, with live counts
Every figure labelled with how it was established; every record has a report path
One Compose Multiplatform codebase for Android, iOS and the web

screenshots.caption: Explore: contract value, status filters and every project at a glance
A project page: money, work done and time used, each with its source
Filters by type, level of government and province, with live counts
Reporting a problem, in six mostly-tap steps

projects.title: WorkBuddy
projects.summary: An Android client for a self-hosted developer dashboard: follow builds live, control remote jobs, and retry failures with AI help.
highlights: 15 modules where Gradle dependency rules enforce Clean Architecture boundaries at compile time
MVVM/MVI state, live build streaming over SSE, remote job control and cancellation
AI-assisted retries and on-device Gemini prompt refinement

projects.title: MyAI
projects.summary: A self-hosted control platform that runs development work on a local PC from chat: tickets in, Claude Code runs, reviewed Git changes out.
highlights: Control plane and execution plane split: runner agents, job queues, streamed logs and audit trails
Lark WebSocket bot and Meegle MCP poller for ticket operations
Confirm-first Git workflow: nothing is pushed without a human yes

projects.title: This portfolio
projects.summary: A Compose Multiplatform app running in your browser through Kotlin/WebAssembly, with a crawlable HTML version generated from the same content at build time.
highlights: Adaptive layout from phone to wide desktop using window size classes
Content lives in one JSON file shared by the app and the generated HTML
Built, tested and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions

screenshots.caption: The page you are on, rendered by Compose from WebAssembly
Project cards with screenshot grids that open a full-screen viewer

highlights: Co-built ArenaPlus V2 from day one and wrote 53% of its code (+270K lines across 413 commits), including the Gradle architecture, UI foundations and navigation
Led the move from a hybrid WebView app to native: ported V2 into the V1 shell as decoupled :v2 modules until the app ran native-only
Built the core wallet flows end to end: deposits, withdrawals, automated bank-linking and a custom Pay & Go withdrawal module
Shipped Arena Social solo in 30 days, turning a web interface into a native app with custom navigators and sticky video playback
Integrated Adjust SDK 5.8 with automated channel attribution, campaign triggers and first-deposit bonus delivery
Optimised the Altenar and Saba sports-betting APIs, built a shake-to-open API debugging tool, and added skeleton loading and bet-validated NBA livestream gating
Integrated third-party eKYC, reduced memory pressure under heavy real-time traffic, and prepared the app for Google Play's 16 KB page sizes
Troubleshot hardware, software and networking issues
Assisted senior engineers with system maintenance, hardware upgrades and enterprise infrastructure migrations
